purpose: KB 2026090003 PRE FROZEN RECONSTRUCTION V1, section 3: inventory of PRE-safe data actually available for the 120 official entrants, per feature family, without manufacturing any missing value.

feature_families.note: K-Ranking enriches an official entrant (per this task's own rule); it is never used as a field-membership source. All 120 official entrants matched.

feature_families.family: Strokes Gained history (current/recent3/recent5/recent10/season2026/multi_season windows x 6 components each: total/tee_to_green/off_the_tee/approach/around_green/putting)
feature_families.note: Every one of the 120 entrants has a profile row (never absent) -- 5 players are labeled 'NO OFFICIAL SG' (no real SG sample exists for them yet), which this audit reports as-is rather than manufacturing a synthetic value for them.

feature_families.family: SG total rank (derived ranking of the above)
M4 win_probability (existing production PRE WIN-only model output)
feature_families.note: This is a DERIVED OUTPUT (a probability), not a raw per-player feature. It cannot itself serve as pre_5prob.py's required expected_round_score_to_par input -- inverting a softmax output back into a raw strokes-to-par value would produce an arbitrary-unit number, not a real score (see KB_2026090003_PRE_5PROB_STATUS.json's 'not_attempted' section, reproduced here rather than re-litigated).

feature_families.family: prior_avg_round_score_to_par (pre_5prob.py's REQUIRED raw score_field, strokes-to-par units)
feature_families.source: NONE -- repository-wide search of every committed content/website_v2/2026090003_*.json artifact found this exact field name only as a metadata label inside 2026090003_PRE_WIN_FORECAST.json's own 'model_features' list (documenting which feature M4 consumed), never as an actual per-player value.
feature_families.why_missing: The underlying inference database (sha256 71a191b7...dac56ee3, 43,741,184 bytes, referenced by 2026090003_PRE_WIN_FORECAST.json's own inference_database block) is not present in this sandbox -- confirmed by a repository-wide search finding zero .sqlite/.db files anywhere in this worktree.

feature_families.family: neo_consistency_stddev (pre_5prob.py's spread_field, same units as the score above)
feature_families.source: NONE -- not present under this exact name in any committed KB artifact.
feature_families.note: A DIFFERENT stddev exists in SG units (2026090003_PRE_PERFORMANCE_SNAPSHOT.json's profiles[*].windows[*].components[*].{sample_sd,population_sd}), but pre_5prob.py's spread parameter must be in the SAME unit as its score parameter (strokes-to-par); substituting an SG-unit stddev for a strokes-to-par-unit stddev without a validated conversion would silently corrupt the Monte Carlo's units. Not attempted, per this task's own 'do not manufacture missing values' rule. pre_5prob.build_pre_sim_inputs does gracefully fall back to a population-mean spread when spread_field is absent -- this classification concerns the harder, non-optional score_field requirement above, which has no such fallback.

feature_families.source: No search for this family was performed beyond confirming it is not referenced anywhere in pre_5prob.py's own required inputs (PreSimInput has exactly two fields: expected_round_score_to_par, spread). Not classified AVAILABLE or MISSING without evidence either way.

feature_families.family: field-strength inputs (relative strength of this specific 120-entrant field vs. historical norms)
feature_families.source: Not required by pre_5prob.py's current implementation (PreSimInput has no field-strength parameter); not searched further.

feature_families.family: empirical historical cut fraction (used by pre_5prob.py's cut logic, not per-player)
feature_families.source: src/klpga/neo_win/pre_5prob.py's DISCLOSED_HISTORICAL_CUT_FRACTION = 336/602, citing docs/SITE_STRUCTURE_TODO.md's own disclosed made_cut split (real evidence, not invented, not KB-specific -- a cross-tournament empirical constant).

publication_relevant_summary.conclusion: pre_5prob.py's hard-required per-player score_field (prior_avg_round_score_to_par) has 0/120 coverage for KB's real field in this sandbox. No probability generation is possible for any of the 120 entrants without either (a) the missing sqlite corpus, or (b) inventing a cross-unit conversion this task's own rules forbid. See KB_2026090003_PRE_PROBABILITY_SNAPSHOT_V1.json.
